answer_1.quote: Lexically Constrained Generation (LCG) is a crucial task of text generation.
answer_1.outputs: Generated texts that include specified keywords while adhering to prompt requirements, such as coherent sentences, recipes, table summaries, or profiles.

answer_2.quote: We introduce two evaluation metrics in this study: 1. Instance Success Rate (R_instance): This metric evaluates whether each generated instance satisfies all specified constraints. 2. Keyword Coverage Rate (S_keyword): This metric measures the proportion of input constraints included in the generated texts.

answer_4.quote: First, we recruited 5 volunteers to manually evaluate the readability of the generated text. Each volunteer rated the text on a scale from 1 to 5, considering factors of coherence, fluency, and readability.
